## Project Specifications:
- **Frontend**: React.js with modern hooks, responsive design matching the provided UI
- **Backend**: Node.js/Express with RESTful APIs
- **Database**: MongoDB for storing property data, users, and search queries
- **Features**: Property listings, search/filter, user auth, property management
- **UI**: Exact match to provided design with property cards, hero section, navigation
